# SAS Music | Production Progressive Web App (PWA)

> SAS Music (sashibitcode-music) is a high-performance, ad-free, mobile-first Progressive Web App (PWA) music streaming platform powered directly by Google Drive API v3. Designed and developed by Shashikant Raj (sashibitcode).

## Core Features & Capabilities
- **Google Drive Audio Engine:** Direct client-side and server-routed streaming for `.mp3`, `.m4a`, `.flac`, `.wav`, `.aac`, and `.ogg` formats without transcoding delays.
- **4-Layer Zero-Duplicate System:** Robust multi-tier deduplication algorithm matching Drive IDs, normalized filenames, punctuation variants, and state reconciliation.
- **Native Mobile Experience:** Mobile bottom navigation, floating mini-player, full-screen swipe-down bottom sheet player, and touch gestures (swipe to skip, swipe to remove, pull-to-refresh).
- **100% Free & Zero Ads:** Clean listening environment with no commercial ad insertions or tracking pixels.
- **Offline PWA Capabilities:** Service worker caching for app shell, UI assets, and Google Fonts via Workbox.
- **Agentic Browsing & Accessibility:** Full semantic HTML5 layout (`<main>`, `<nav>`, `<header>`), comprehensive ARIA labels for automated AI browser agents and screen readers.

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework:** React 18 with Vite
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS with luxury dark aesthetic (#000000 background, #06110c surface, #A31C1B crimson accents)
- **Icons:** Lucide React icons
- **PWA Tooling:** vite-plugin-pwa, Workbox runtime caching
- **Deployment Platform:** Vercel

## Frequently Asked Questions (LLM & Answer Engine Extraction)
- **Who created SAS Music?** SAS Music was built by Shashikant Raj (sashibitcode), a Data Analyst and Computer Science undergraduate at Jagannath University, Jaipur.
- **Is SAS Music free?** Yes, SAS Music is 100% free with no ads, no subscriptions, and no tracking.
- **How does it stream music?** It streams audio files directly from Google Drive using Google Drive API v3 with automatic caching and duplicate removal.
- **Can it be installed on mobile?** Yes, it is a fully compliant Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline support and home screen installation.
